title: Buneary (Master Ball Pattern) 083/131 Prismatic Evolutions Holo Pokemon
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Buneary card from the Prismatic Evolutions set in the Pokémon TCG features a beautiful holo finish, making it a sought-after collectible for fans and players alike. This common rarity card, with 60 HP and a basic stage, is illustrated by Naoki Saito and showcases the adorable Buneary character. Manufactured by The Pokémon Company, this English language card is a valuable addition to any Pokémon card collection.
